Method, not numbers.

elements.title: GAPPRI taxi sequence
elements.text: "AVA 7031 taxi to runway 22R via A, N. Cross runway 13R and hold short of 13L." → "Re-cleared A1, B, N, cross 13R, hold short 13L." → "You were not cleared to cross 13 right!" → "Runway 22R now closed, taxi via 13L, left on M short of R, expect departure 22L at N3." → "Line up and wait runway 22L at N3." → "Cleared for take-off."
elements.summary: The runway-incursion teaching sequence, six calls.

elements.title: Glideslope from above

elements.title: LOFT - line-oriented flight, domestic sector
elements.text: Full line-oriented flight from gate to gate with one crew acting as in real life. Instructor sets cockpit and FMS; nav charts, take-off and landing performance done in the briefing; a maximum of 15 minutes cockpit set-up.

elements.title: Line-oriented transit
elements.text: 40-minute transit (45 max) between two evaluation sectors: external power, chocks, doors, refuelling with passengers on board, maintenance intervention, new flight plan by ACARS, weather improving during the transit.
elements.summary: EVAL: workload management under realistic interruptions.

elements.title: GAPPRI - runway incursion prevention, taxi
elements.text: Threat assessment and taxi briefing, clearance verification, taxi monitoring, runway crossing, managing uncertainty (STOP - CLARIFY - VERIFY), workload during engine start, departure change, take-off preparation, FAA taxi clearance philosophy.
elements.summary: SBT: training only. Taxi with ATC re-clearances and one deliberate trap.

elements.title: ISI - phases of a crosswind landing
elements.text: Exercise 1: instructor demonstration of flare and de-crab technique, directional control with reverse idle on a contaminated runway. Exercise 2: each pilot performs one landing in contaminated conditions; autobrake disconnected without callout on one roll-out.
elements.summary: SBT: crosswind landing demonstration and practice.

elements.title: HPS - emergency descent + TCAS
elements.text: Decompression at instructor discretion; TCAS RA once a heading is established in the descent. Focus on speed decay, thrust management and speed brakes.

elements.title: Cold weather operations and de-icing
elements.text: Scenario starts after pushback with engines running. Review of de-icing procedures, After Start supplementary procedure, iceman coordination, engine ice shedding during taxi; concludes at the runway holding point and transitions into the check without interruption.
elements.summary: SBT: winter operations from the gate to the runway.

elements.title: LVO rejected take-off
elements.text: Take-off clearance cancelled at high speed, by surprise. Complete once the crew has done the assessment and associated duties.

elements.title: Engine failure at V1
elements.text: Engine stall at V1 and failure at 10 ft HAT: a loud bang followed by a failure without damage. Let the pilots continue until the assessment for damage is complete; freeze and explain the damage concept.

elements.title: Automatic approach (CAT III single) + manual go-around
elements.text: AWO checklist prepared in the briefing. Autopilot failure below 200 ft, autoland warning light on, manual go-around.
elements.summary: Check manoeuvre: AWO with a failure at minimum.

elements.title: Single-engine autoland (CAT III single)
elements.text: CAT II weather, approach lights maximum. After autoland and reverser deployment trigger one of: nose-wheel steering fault, visibility 0/0 during the roll, reverser fault, no roll-out, autopilot disconnection at touchdown.
elements.summary: Check manoeuvre: SE autoland with a roll-out event chosen at delivery.

elements.title: Manual single-engine approach and landing
elements.text: Manual CAT I single-engine approach, released after the GAPPRI part 2 briefing; landing roll with a taxi instruction that includes a runway crossing.

elements.title: MTV - breakout from a simultaneous parallel approach
elements.text: Breakout to the right; climb or descend at instructor discretion; the manoeuvre concludes once ATC re-clears the aircraft to climb. Mind the MSA.

elements.title: UPRT - manual raw-data ILS with teardrop, bounce and visual pattern
elements.text: Both FDs failed. Manual flying, raw data, full ILS with a teardrop letdown from the north; bounce on landing, go-around, visual traffic pattern; second crew member flies the approach, go-around and pattern. Manual braking on roll-out.
elements.summary: Training only: reinforcement of handling skills (non-evaluative).

elements.title: Fuel leak after the fuel metering valve
elements.text: Reaching cruise, engine fuel leak. The 30-minute fuel check against the flight plan may be the first indication; fuel used + FOB at the gate may still look correct. Land ASAP; shut the engine down per QRH; analyse cross-feed and remaining fuel.

elements.title: Fuel leak before the fuel metering valve
elements.text: Tank fuel leak, left inner. Freeze on detection or ECAM; discuss leak rate; land ASAP with cross-feed closed; consider engine relight; allow the engine to fail from starvation to demonstrate.

elements.title: Fuel leak on the centre tank
elements.text: Tankering flight, GEN 1 deferred, APU on. Fuel leak centre tank after take-off; fuel check at a checkpoint shows EFOB below expected. Analyse APU shutdown despite the deferred generator; QRH.

elements.title: Stabilised decelerated approach
elements.text: Review the fuel-leak checklist items for approach; with the simulation frozen, stabilised approach criteria and actions; G/S from above induced as ATC; ATC speed constraint; callouts and actions at 1 000 ft AFE; no reverse at landing.
elements.summary: SBT: stabilised approach under a fuel-leak constraint.

elements.title: Reinforcement
elements.text: Repetition or strengthening of any training need the crew has or the instructor has identified, at any point in the session, never cut for an early departure.

elements.title: Session briefing
elements.text: Briefing per the Briefing Guide: TEM framing, LOSA findings the module covers, training elements, nav charts and performance.

elements.title: Facilitated debriefing
elements.text: Facilitated debriefing per the Briefing Guide; Day 1 assigns the Day 2 preparation tasks.

elements.title: Day 1 grading
elements.text: On Day 1 only the EVAL sections are evaluated. SBT 1 (GAPPRI) and HPS are training only and must not be considered in the day's summative assessment.

elements.title: Reinforcement time is never cut
elements.text: Under no circumstances is reinforcement time cut for an early departure. Both days are completed in their entirety, each session lasting the full period.

elements.title: Snapshot discipline
elements.text: Take a snapshot where the section says so and recall it for reinforcement at the end of the session.
